```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)


# Function to clean bib file by removing annotation fields
clean_bib_file <- function(input_file, output_file) {
  # Read file content with UTF-8 encoding
  content <- readLines(input_file, encoding = "UTF-8")
  
  # Variables to track annotation field parsing
  in_annotation <- FALSE
  brace_count <- 0
  cleaned_lines <- c()
  
  # Process each line
  for (line in content) {
    # Check if this line starts an annotation field
    if (grepl("^\\s*annotation\\s*=", line)) {
      in_annotation <- TRUE
      # Count braces in this line
      open_braces <- lengths(regmatches(line, gregexpr("\\{", line)))
      close_braces <- lengths(regmatches(line, gregexpr("\\}", line)))
      brace_count <- open_braces - close_braces
      
      # If annotation field ends on the same line
      if (brace_count <= 0) {
        in_annotation <- FALSE
      }
      next  # Skip this line
    }
    
    # If we're inside an annotation field
    if (in_annotation) {
      # Update brace count
      open_braces <- lengths(regmatches(line, gregexpr("\\{", line)))
      close_braces <- lengths(regmatches(line, gregexpr("\\}", line)))
      brace_count <- brace_count + open_braces - close_braces
      
      # If braces are balanced, annotation field ends
      if (brace_count <= 0) {
        in_annotation <- FALSE
      }
      next  # Skip this line
    }
    
    # Keep this line
    cleaned_lines <- c(cleaned_lines, line)
  }
  
  # Write cleaned content to output file
  writeLines(cleaned_lines, output_file, useBytes = TRUE)
  
  # Print completion message
  cat("Cleaning completed!\n")
  cat("Original file:", input_file, "\n")
  cat("Cleaned file:", output_file, "\n")
}

# Execute cleaning process
clean_bib_file("thesis_co.bib", "thesis_co_clean.bib")

# Check cleaning results
original_lines <- length(readLines("thesis_co.bib"))
cleaned_lines <- length(readLines("thesis_co_clean.bib"))

cat("\nCleaning Summary:\n")
cat("Original file lines:", original_lines, "\n")
cat("Cleaned file lines:", cleaned_lines, "\n")
cat("Lines removed:", original_lines - cleaned_lines, "\n")
```
